title: Warm Canadian Lemon Pudding
description: A sweet and pillowy Canadian dessert featuring lemons, this warm pudding is a cozy treat for any time of day, made with a nut-free friendly recipe.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the sugar, flour, and lemon zest.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and whisk until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla extract and salt.
Pour the mixture into 4 to 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the puddings warm, garnished with additional lemon zest if desired.
